results.details: Principal, tenant, role and permission provenance are server-derived; resource owner and content-right facts come from the owning service; client role, tenant, owner or approval fields cannot grant authority; RBAC bindings feed ABAC rules and missing facts deny by default.

Adult eligibility and required consent retain policy/document versions, evidence digests, withdrawal, restriction and revalidation semantics; birth input or a client checkbox cannot directly pass a protected route.

The normal hot path uses a service-local PEP with verified JWT, local resource facts and a versioned policy bundle; only high-risk, dynamic or safe-cache-miss cases call the structured PDP with trusted service identity, and uncertainty fails closed.

Eight policy control operations cover immutable draft, submit, independent approval, activation and revocation; audit links, idempotency, second-person decisions and cache invalidation receipts are mandatory.

Twenty-one OpenAPI and fourteen event fragments merge without drift; five generated files are current; 377 operations, 536 schemas and 154 events validate; both TypeScript packages typecheck; the immutable Git baseline reports zero breaking OpenAPI, event and JSON Schema changes.

The policy audit covers 8/8 operations and 30 policy schemas; 13/13 failure-closed mutations, P1R 72/72, B8 29/29 and G1 6/6 pass; independent reviewer m1_003_final_review revalidated the original acceptance at e4618b324e5a93926da0750a8100fc9377ac97ec using gpt-5.6-luna Max.

ADR, security boundaries, architecture, business-operation design and contract guide share the same Phase 1 role vocabulary, authority provenance, policy lifecycle and PEP/PDP boundary; legacy tenant-admin and privacy-operator names are explicitly not Phase 1 aliases.
